Sources shown here belong to the active database. Older imported databases may provide citations only in individual entries.

This is an unofficial reference. Definitions have not all been independently verified for operational use. Reuse terms are specific to each source.
Changes stay on this device across app and glossary updates. Original source references are preserved. Export the glossary to save a portable copy.

Open a term and tap Edit to change its acronym, meaning or notes. Add your reference if you have one. Original citations remain available under View sources; personal edits are clearly labelled.

Use Add term for new entries. Removed terms and all your edits appear under My changes. Restore term undoes a removal. Discard personal changes restores the active database entry, or deletes a personal addition.

Changes and favourites stay with their glossary collection and survive its updates. Use bundled glossary switches to the database packaged in this edition. Changes remain attached to their collection. Reimport your database to return to its saved changes. Older databases without a collection ID share the legacy personal collection.

Export glossary saves the visible glossary, including your changes, as an importable .db file. It does not include favourites or undo history. After importing an export, those entries belong to that database. Keep an export before uninstalling: uninstalling erases local data. The app has no network permission and does not upload your glossary.
